from pathlib import Path
import hashlib

p = Path('.runtime/bridge_recovery_e001.txt')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
payload = 'bridge recovery explicit-route code execution PASS\n'
p.write_text(payload, encoding='utf-8')
readback = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert readback == payload
print('BRIDGE_RECOVERY_CODE=PASS')
print(f'SHA256={hashlib.sha256(readback.encode()).hexdigest()}')
